entries.decision: Short finite servile root with dependent uninflected lexical verb/root. Unifies general permission and formal authorization; source is optional and expressed by the EXISTING ablative -de in the narrowly specified post-modal/pre-infinitive valency slot: auti umande mov = permitted by a person to move. auti umande mov domde distinguishes grant-source umande from movement-source domde. pos opportunity/feasibility is not normative permission, nor does aut entail execution. no auti V denies permission; auti no V permits refraining; neither lack of permission nor lack of obligation automatically entails an explicit prohibition (debi no V). Source-qualified denial applies only to the cited grantor. The spelling auth with h and generic bound aut- are not ratified. Extending -in to normative or other abstract domains remains open; Phase 1 parser does not implement this frame.

entries.decision: Possession of knowledge, distinct from kap understanding and pens thinking. Regular phase morphology applies, with contextual aspectual restrictions. Author-approved 2026-11-12: sap also licenses a finite sap + bare lexical infinitive/root frame meaning procedural know-how (sapi mov = I know how to move). Know-how alone does not entail pot capacity, pos opportunity or realized action; no sapi V negates the know-how relation, sapi no V is know-how of refraining from V. Other lexical knowing senses remain intact.
Ratify standalone se as IF, distinct from confirmed si YES and no NO/NOT. No automatic ratification of then/tum, ergo, nisi, sin, sed or other connective forms.
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24, Latin si adapted to distinguish si=yes

entries.decision: Confirmed unit root sekun for seconds, invariant after numeric quantity. This denotes duration units, not the ordinal second (bisim).
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-11-13; international second/seconde adapted to Unisermo

entries.decision: Bound measurement prefix, exactly one per confirmed unit, fused without separator; distinct from cardinal numeral mila. Preserve original magnitude and name, do not stack prefixes.

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy centr. The bare root sentr is preferred over former sentrum to preserve a compact derivational base and avoid an unnecessary nominal ending.
Canonical replacement for legacy cert.

For bounded positive-duration event intervals, directional relation A sim B iff end(A)=start(B). A and B are semantic placeholders, not automatically valid finite-clause syntax. Inverse relation is obtained by reversing operands. Lexical form confirmed; parser and finite-clause linking syntax require separate implementation.
entries.meaning_en: directed temporal meeting: A ends exactly as B begins
entries.meaning_it: A finisce esattamente quando B comincia

entries.decision: For bounded positive-duration event intervals, directional relation A simpost B iff start(B)<start(A) and end(A)=end(B). A and B are semantic placeholders, not automatically valid finite-clause syntax. Inverse relation is obtained by reversing operands. Lexical form confirmed; parser and finite-clause linking syntax require separate implementation.
entries.meaning_it: A e B terminano insieme; A comincia dopo

entries.decision: For bounded positive-duration event intervals, directional relation A simpre B iff start(A)=start(B) and end(A)<end(B). A and B are semantic placeholders, not automatically valid finite-clause syntax. Inverse relation is obtained by reversing operands. Lexical form confirmed; parser and finite-clause linking syntax require separate implementation.
entries.meaning_it: A e B iniziano insieme; A termina prima

entries.decision: For bounded event intervals A=[a0,a1], B=[b0,b1], A simtem B iff a0=b0 and a1=b1. No event identity is entailed. Schematic A/B examples are not approved finite-clause syntax. The form is a lexicalized temporal relation, not blanket productive compounding. `temekwal` retired as the former spelling; `ekwal` remains the independent general equality term.
entries.meaning_en: exact equality of two event temporal extents, without identity of events
entries.meaning_it: coincidenza esatta degli intervalli temporali di due eventi
entries.origin: Author ratification 2026-11-14: simtem replaces prior confirmed temekwal; sim- temporal family

entries.decision: Universal approximation operator on a numerical scalar, tolerance contextual. Does not automatically mean epistemic uncertainty. No property-specific arithmetic bound.
entries.meaning_en: approximately; about, applied to a quantitative value
entries.meaning_it: circa; approssimativamente, per un valore quantitativo
entries.origin: Author ratification 2026-11-13; Latin circa, written Unisermo with s for /s/

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy circul. User-supplied sircul is normalized to sirkul because c is not in the canonical alphabet.
Canonical replacement for legacy civ.

Technological qualification, not human intelligence. smart fon identifies a smartphone; smart can qualify other technological devices. The noun fon remains broad enough to include historic fixed telephones.
entries.meaning_en: smart (technology); equipped with advanced computing functions beyond a basic version
entries.meaning_it: intelligente in senso tecnologico; dotato di funzioni informatiche avanzate

entries.decision: For bounded positive-duration event intervals, directional relation A solap B iff start(A)<start(B)<end(A)<end(B). A and B are semantic placeholders, not automatically valid finite-clause syntax. Inverse relation is obtained by reversing operands. Lexical form confirmed; parser and finite-clause linking syntax require separate implementation.
entries.meaning_en: directed partial overlap: A begins before B, ends during B
entries.meaning_it: A comincia prima di B e termina durante B

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy spec.
Canonical replacement for legacy struct.
Analytic sufficiency operator: reaches contextual requirement; not a fixed degree or synonym of mult.
entries.meaning_en: sufficiently; enough relative to a purpose or threshold
entries.meaning_it: sufficientemente; quanto basta rispetto a uno scopo o una soglia

entries.decision: Canonical invariant free temporal relator. Former suffix -tem is retired. Author ratification 2026-11-13: for bounded event-interval operands A tem B, require start(B)<start(A)<end(A)<end(B), excluding shared boundaries; no automatic clausal syntax licensing. Nominal tem dia remains valid.
entries.meaning_en: during / at the time of (nominal frame); strict containment between bounded positive-duration event intervals
entries.meaning_it: durante / nel tempo di (frase nominale); contenimento stretto fra intervalli di eventi delimitati

entries.decision: Distinct from fer acquisition, portar transport, and ines persistence of a state. Standard phase prefix family adten/inten/deten/reten.
entries.meaning_en: hold; maintain a constraint or control relation over time
entries.meaning_it: tenere; mantenere un vincolo o controllo nel tempo

entries.decision: Ordinary finite servile root governing one uninflected dependent lexical verb with shared subject and existing verb-governed arguments. Attempt entails a real goal-directed effort but not successful completion, opportunity, capacity or permission. no tenti V denies attempting; tenti no V means try to refrain from V. Not a generic intentionality marker or an aspect. Distinct from ten and does not itself retire stud.
entries.meaning_en: attempt; undertake an actual goal-directed effort to realize a dependent event
entries.meaning_it: tentare; compiere un tentativo effettivo e orientato a uno scopo

entries.decision: Canonical force/manner verb for pull. It describes traction/pulling and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.
entries.origin: Latin trahere / tract-; international traction-tractor family

entries.meaning_it: treno; veicolo ferroviario composto da uno o più elementi destinati a muoversi sui binari
entries.meaning_en: train; railway vehicle or connected set of railway vehicles
entries.decision: Canonical common noun for train, used in transport and motion constructions. No special motion semantics: the noun itself does not assert movement.

Canonical human/person root replacing earlier om. Optional referential specificity gives umano (male person/man) and umane (female person/woman); explicit plural is wi uman. Abstract humanity is regularly umanitat via -itat.
Canonical replacement for legacy voc.

Short finite servile root plus bare infinitive. no voli V denies desire to act; voli no V expresses desire that one not act. Volition/desire alone does not entail a decision or adopted plan, attempted action, action itself, or ability. Separate approved int for committed intention and tent for actual attempt (2026-11-13).
entries.meaning_en: want; desire an event or action
entries.meaning_it: volere; desiderare che un'azione o evento si realizzi
entries.origin: Author approval 2026-11-12; Latin velle/volo; Romance volere and international volition
